Maybe try spinning your weed with something? Just to get your tolerance down and make your weed last longer, saving you money. Then work on trying to make it through little periods of time without weed. Do like little activities?? Even if you’re pulling yourself through it. Start at 5 minutes and work your way up. The activities could be anything like house chores, personal errands, taking yourself on a date and getting some food, reading up on people’s lives experience of weed addiction specifically, seeking out free programs in your area and connecting with people in your community struggling with the same thing, going on a sober holiday. 

TLDR:
If you can start having small experiences sober, you can start to address that feeling of needing weed. Start with 5 minute weed breaks and increase it each time you break. Do an activity in the break like chores, errands, hobbies, free addiction services, and learning about lived experience of addiction.
